appDesc.message: Simplifies Nexus Mods downloads, manages collection download queues, and keeps a local history of completed files.

btnReportBug.message: Report a bug — copies error report

popupFooter.message: Download helper for Nexus Mods & Vortex

ratingPrompt.message: Enjoying it? ⭐ Star it on GitHub

welcomeSubtitle.message: Download Nexus Mods files and whole collections with less clicking — queued, paced and resumable.

step1Title.message: Open any Nexus Mods file page

step1Text.message: Click a download button — the extension prepares the download link and starts the download for you.

step2Text.message: Open any collection page and use the Collection Downloader deck to fetch every mod with one click.

step3Text.message: Click the extension icon for quick toggles, or the ⚙ button on any Nexus page for full settings.

privacyCardText.message: No analytics, no accounts, no external servers. Everything stays in your browser.

bugCardText.message: Every "Report a bug" button copies a full diagnostic report and opens a prefilled GitHub issue.

starCardText.message: A star on GitHub helps more modders find the extension.

disclaimer.message: Not affiliated with Nexus Mods. You need your own Nexus Mods account; premium-only content stays premium-only.

errMissingFileMsg.message: This download link does not include a file identifier.
errMissingFileMsg.description: Error message: the link had no file id.

errMissingFileFix.message: Open the file page and try again.

errTimeoutMsg.message: Nexus Mods took too long to respond.

errOfflineFix.message: Reconnect to the internet, then retry.

errNetworkErrorMsg.message: The request to Nexus Mods could not be completed.

errRequiresLoginMsg.message: You are not signed in to Nexus Mods.

errRequiresLoginFix.message: Sign in, return to this page, then retry the download.

errCloudflareMsg.message: Nexus Mods needs a browser verification before continuing.

errCloudflareFix.message: Complete the verification on the file page, then retry.

errRateLimitedMsg.message: Nexus Mods is temporarily rate limiting requests.

errRateLimitedFix.message: Wait a few minutes before trying again.

errAccountSuspendedMsg.message: Nexus Mods temporarily suspended further download requests.
errAccountSuspendedMsg.description: Error message: account throttled by Nexus.

errAccountSuspendedFix.message: Wait before trying again to avoid extending the suspension.

errAccessDeniedMsg.message: Nexus Mods denied access to this download.

errAccessDeniedFix.message: Check your account permissions and the file page, then retry.

errFileNotFoundMsg.message: The requested file was not found on Nexus Mods.

errFileNotFoundFix.message: The file may have been removed or the link is outdated.

errModerationHoldMsg.message: This file is under moderation review.
errModerationHoldMsg.description: Error message: file held for moderation.

errModerationHoldFix.message: Wait for Nexus Mods to approve the file before downloading.

errServerErrorMsg.message: Nexus Mods is having a server-side problem.

errInvalidResponseMsg.message: Nexus Mods returned an unexpected response.

errInvalidResponseFix.message: Refresh the file page and retry.

errNoDownloadUrlMsg.message: Nexus Mods did not return a usable download link.
errNoDownloadUrlMsg.description: Error message: no browser download URL.

errNoDownloadUrlFix.message: Open the file page, check that you are signed in, then retry.

errNoNmmLinkMsg.message: Nexus Mods did not return a valid Vortex link.
errNoNmmLinkMsg.description: Error message: no nxm:// link. Vortex is a product name, keep it untranslated.

errNoNmmLinkFix.message: Check the file page and retry, or switch to Browser Download.

errAbortedMsg.description: Error message: user pressed Stop or the route changed. Has no recovery text.

errUnsafeDownloadUrlMsg.message: The download link Nexus Mods returned was not a recognised download target.
errUnsafeDownloadUrlMsg.description: Error message: URL failed the download-target allowlist.

errUnsafeDownloadUrlFix.message: Open the file page and download manually. If this keeps happening, report the issue.

errContextInvalidMsg.message: The extension was updated or reloaded while this page was open.

errContextInvalidFix.message: Refresh this Nexus Mods page, then retry.

errRequestFailedFix.message: Retry the download. If it keeps happening, report the issue.

setAutoStartDownloadDesc.message: When you open a Nexus file download page, start the Vortex handoff or browser download without another click.

setAutoCloseTabDesc.message: After a Vortex link is sent, close the temporary Nexus tab after the delay below.

setSkipRequirementsDesc.message: Continue past Nexus requirements popups and go straight to the download step.

setShowAlertsOnErrorDesc.message: Show a clear message when Nexus does not return a usable download link.

setHidePremiumUpsellsDesc.message: Hides ads and Premium banners. It also bypasses the 5-second countdown timer for downloads.

setHandleArchivedFilesDesc.message: Add Vortex and browser download buttons to archived file entries when Nexus hides them.

setDebugLogsDesc.message: Print detailed NexusMods Bypass activity in the console. Errors are always shown, and bug reports are unaffected by this setting.

setDownloadFolderDesc.message: Subfolder inside your browser Downloads directory, used by Browser Download mode. Leave it empty to save straight into Downloads — some mod managers only watch that folder and never look inside subfolders. Vortex downloads are handled by Vortex and are unaffected.

setRequestTimeoutDesc.message: How long the extension waits for Nexus to return a download link before it gives up.

setCloseTabDelayDesc.message: Only applies to auto-started Vortex downloads that close their tab. Increase it if Vortex misses links.

setDownloadSpeedDesc.message: Vortex mode only. The browser cannot watch a transfer happening inside Vortex, so this estimates how long each file takes and spaces the hand-offs out. Set it to the speed you actually see — too low and the queue waits far longer than it needs to.

setPauseBetweenModsDesc.message: Vortex mode only. Added to the estimate above. Set it to 0 to switch the wait off entirely — including the size estimate — and hand every file to Vortex back to back, letting Vortex queue them itself.
